name: link
purpose: Helps users move between views or sections. Migrated from the existing implementation at `packages/webkit/src/components/navigation/link/`. Design source: [Webkit — Link](https://www.figma.com/design/t97pXRs7xME3SJDs5iZ5RF/Webkit?node-id=3548-578) (`Size` × `State` variants; hover handled in CSS).
useWhen: A standalone navigation link: a domain, a repository, a docs page, "View all".
An in-console navigation action ("Add custom domain"): no trailing icon unless `icon` is set.
avoidWhen: A link inside a sentence → use a plain anchor with the text-link class.
An action that changes something instead of navigating → use `button`.
A compact marketing CTA with a brand-colored icon inside a card → use `mini-button`.
related: mini-button` — same anatomy in default text color with a brand-colored icon; `large` and `medium` only.
button` — set `href` when a link must look like a button.
breadcrumb` — a trail of links for hierarchical location.
bestPractices: Always set `href` and a label that names the destination; an empty `href` renders `#` so the anchor stays focusable, and an empty label falls back to the locale catalog (`Learn more`).
Pass the label as the default slot or the `label` prop; the slot wins when both are set.
target="_blank"` adds `rel="noopener noreferrer"` and, when `icon` is empty, the `pi pi-external-link` glyph so an off-site link reads as one; same-tab links show no icon unless `icon` is set.
An icon is shown when `icon` is set; `showIcon` is deprecated.
Match `size` to the controls around it; heights follow `button` (40 / 32 / 28 px).
disabled` drops it from the tab order and suppresses `click`; hide a link that can never be followed instead.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label, the default slot's fallback. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Learn more`).

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects height and typography (large 40px, medium 32px, small 28px), matching Button.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: showIcon
props.doc: @deprecated since 6.0 — use `icon` (set shows it, empty hides it). Removed in 7.0. `false` hides the icon; `true` shows `icon`, or `pi pi-external-link` when `icon` is empty.

props.name: icon
props.doc: PrimeIcons class for the trailing icon; set shows it. Empty shows `pi pi-external-link` only when `target` is `_blank`.

props.name: href
props.doc: Destination URL for the anchor. Empty renders `#`.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The link text. Fallback: `label`, then the locale catalog.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Link from '@aziontech/webkit/link'
</script>

<template>
  <Link
    label="Learn more"
    size="large"
    href="https://example.com/docs"
    target="_blank"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Sizes
Disabled
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Link from '@aziontech/webkit/link'
</script>

<template>
  <Link
    label="Learn more"
    icon="pi pi-external-link"
    disabled
  />
</template>
